details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: [fanfare] Put a Remnant of Hollowness token into your EX area. [act] [cost00]: The next Loot card you play this turn costs 2 less. Activate only twice per turn. [act] Banish an Octrice, Omen of Usurpation from your cemetery: Put a Gilded Blade, Gilded Goblet, or Gilded Boots token into your EX area.

issues: The [act] [cost00] ability is encoded as a generic playCostReduction on this card; it should grant cost reduction only to the next Loot card you play this turn, e.g. use grantNextPlayCostReduction with a Loot filter and amount 2.
The [act] [cost00] ability is marked oncePerTurn: true, but the source says 'Activate only twice per turn'; remove oncePerTurn and keep maxPerTurn: 2.

The second [act] ability is incorrectly set to activateFrom: 'cemetery' with banishSelf cost; it should be an activated ability from the field whose cost banishes an 'Octrice, Omen of Usurpation' from your cemetery.
The second [act] ability only creates Gilded Blade; it should let you choose one of Gilded Blade, Gilded Goblet, or Gilded Boots and put the chosen token into your EX area.

details.effect: [evolve] [cost02]: Evolve this follower. [evolve] [cost00]: Evolve this follower. This ability can be activated if there are at least 10 cards in opponents' cemeteries. [fanfare] Each opponent puts the top 2 cards of their deck into their cemetery. [act] [cost08]: Select a card in an opponent's cemetery and play it for 0 play points.

issues: The base card is missing the alternate [evolve] [cost00] ability conditioned on there being at least 10 cards in opponents' cemeteries; add an evolve-timing ability or equivalent evolve cost line with condition opponentCemeteryMin 10 and cost 0.

The [act] [cost08] ability uses playFromOpponentCemetery with filter.cardType 'card', which is invalid; encode it as selecting any card in an opponent's cemetery for play for 0 PP without the invalid cardType field.

details.effect: On Evolve: Select a card in an opponent's cemetery and put it into your EX area. [act] [cost08]: Select a card in an opponent's cemetery and play it for 0 play points. If there are at least 10 cards in opponents' cemeteries, any card you play from the EX area costs 2 less.

issues: On Evolve is encoded with tutorFromCemetery, which refers to your cemetery; it should select a card in an opponent's cemetery and put it into your EX area.

The passive cost reduction is encoded as a generic playCostReduction on this card; it should reduce the cost of any card you play from the EX area by 2 while the opponentCemeteryMin 10 condition holds, not reduce this card's own play cost.
